<DOCSTRING>
Bundles an error indicating an email is not valid into the error hierarchy.

Description:
This class is a subclass of ValueError and is used to represent errors where an email address is not valid. It is part of the error hierarchy in the system, providing a specific type of error that can be caught and handled separately from other types of errors.

Attributes:
    message (str): The error message describing why the email is not valid, set during initialization.
</DOCSTRING>
